searchText: If these still need to be tested, I would be willing, but might have some questions. Do I just need to deploy a contract to test the base fee opcode? Yes, that would do it for 3198 If you are deploying a contract, it might be worth also looking at EIP-3529 and trying to test the various SSTORE refund cases too 🙂 OK. I’ll review EIP-3529 and see if I can come up with something. Same :) Hey Tim! Nice to see you on here I think I have a base fee test ready, but I’m not sure how I would perform the test cases in EIP-3529 from my contract since each case provides byte code. I’m using solidity and changing the opcode in my get function after compile. Since solidity doesn’t appear to support base fee yet? If there is a better way to test these I’m all ears.
